entries.title: Draft: linear robust replacement margins in uniform FPP
entries.statement: Draft self-proved special case; independent review pending. On undirected nearest-neighbour Z^2 with iid Uniform[1,2] edge times and endpoints 0,n e1, integer n>=9, let gamma be the almost-sure unique geodesic and A_e the minimum passage time over paths avoiding e. The expected number of e in gamma with A_e-T(0,n e1)>=1/128 is at least n/2048. A fixed-path independence bound followed by a union over simple paths proves this marginal statement. It gives no persistence guarantee under positive coordinate resampling, and does not solve the KPZ exponent problem.
assumptions: Independent audit of campaign proof pending

entries.title: Draft: bound the uniform FPP covariance floor by independent overlap
entries.statement: Draft bridge; independent review pending. For iid Uniform[1,2] undirected nearest-neighbour FPP on Z^2, endpoints 0,n e1, define T_n and L_n=sum_e Var(E[T_n|tau_e]). For endpoint geodesics gamma and gamma' in independent whole environments, L_n<=E|gamma intersect gamma'|/4=sum_e P(e in gamma)^2/4. The conditional mean in tau_e is monotone with range P(e in gamma), so the bounded-range variance inequality proves the bridge. Dembin-Elboim-Peled arXiv:2307.01162v2, equation (1.4) and Corollary 1.3 at d=2,beta=2, applies because Uniform[1,2] is absolutely continuous on a bounded positive interval with density at least 1. Thus L_n<=C n^(2/3)(log n)^2 for n>=2. This does not bound the centered covariance at positive noise.
assumptions: Published independent-overlap theorem invoked with full density/support hypotheses
Independent audit of the campaign bridge pending

entries.title: Unproved: centered threshold crossover needed for uniform FPP KPZ
entries.statement: Unproved sufficient input, not a theorem. For iid Uniform[1,2] undirected Z^2 FPP with endpoints 0,n e1, put U_e=tau_e-1 and a_e=clamp(A_e-B_e-1,0,1), where A_e is the cheapest avoiding path and B_e the cheapest containing path with e's weight omitted. Let U_-e^(1-s) independently refresh each other coordinate with probability s. For K(a,b)=Cov(min(U,a),min(U,b)), U Uniform[0,1], define J_n(rho)=sum_e E K(a_e(U_-e),a_e(U_-e^rho)) and R_n=J_n-J_n(0). The exact finite-product identity gives Var(T_n)=J_n(0)+integral_0^1 R_n(rho)d rho. A sufficient missing lemma would, for each 0<epsilon<1/3, give n-independent c,C>0, eta>0,p>1 with R_n(1-s)<=Cn(1+s n^(1/3-epsilon))^(-p) for all s in [0,1], and sum_e P(a_e>=eta,a_e^(1-s)>=eta)>=cn for s<=n^(-1/3-epsilon), for all large n. Together with the checked first-order floor bound these inputs imply Var(T_n)=n^(2/3+o(1)). Only zero-noise robust margins and a window of order n^(-2) have been proved in this packet.
assumptions: Displayed upper envelope and lower persistence are UNPROVED

relations.rationale: The conditional exponent inference uses the floor bound L_n<=C n^(2/3)(log n)^2 from floor-bridge and the centered-envelope/lower-persistence inputs stated in open-crossover.

robust-margins gives an expected n/2048 geodesic edges with replacement slack >=1/128 at zero noise. open-crossover requires a cn robust-threshold overlap throughout a polynomial positive-noise window; the latter is explicitly not proved by the former.
